title: M0 · Recon & Bootstrap
description: Prerequisites, Bryntum and organiser questions, repo + CI, local stack, integration spikes recording real fixtures (PayPal orders/tracking, disputes, webhooks; OpenAI), Render pipeline, Bryntum spike.

title: M1 · Walking Skeleton
description: Domain core, schema, outbox + worker, webhook ingest, auth + demo workspaces, design system, a skeleton dashboard deployed to Render, observability baseline.

title: M2 · Dispute Loop
description: Evidence intake, agent harness, extraction, two-pass scope check, proof-pack UI, dispute ingest + deadline watcher, dispute draft + compiled PDF, action governance, dispute UI, judge scenario runner with the labelled sandbox decision.

title: M3 · Holds & Cash
description: Holds + explanations, tracking + carrier map + route advice, guided Completed, cash calendar, client acknowledgement, scope snapshot, email alerts, reconcile/SLO/synthetic checks, review-hold pool; the storyboard runs for real on production.

title: M4 · Trust & Global
description: Gold sets + eval suite, Hindi + currency/time-zone formatting, accessibility + performance, security review, load test, judging runbook + retention.

title: M5 · Submission
description: README, video, Devpost text, then M5-CLEANUP, M5-GATE from a clean clone, then submit (repo public only with the owner's OK).
